findings.message: This pass edited deploy/smoke.txt, which is outside the build's writable areas, and deleted two post-deploy smoke rows — `GET /MenuApi 200` and `GET /StoreInfoApi 200` — for the two public read endpoints this pass did not otherwise touch. Nothing in the diff changes MenuApi or StoreInfoApi, so there is no stated reason for the rows to go, and their removal is a quiet reduction of the only per-deploy proof that the customer-facing menu and shop-info endpoints answer at all (rule 12's smoke table). The trailing-slash normalisation on the three 403 rows is harmless; the two deletions should be restored unless there is a measured reason they cannot pass.

`managed-fields-probe` was registered in package.json by hand. The template's rule for a new probe is to write only `scripts/<name>-probe.js` and leave package.json alone, because the registration entry is written in code after this stage (CLAUDE.md §7.30, issue #136). The probe file itself is correct — `freezeClock()`, `process.exit(done())`, synthesized negative controls, and it reads `ROOT`/`checker` from a harness that does export both — so this is only the registration step done twice.

summary: The build fixes the long-unexplained 400 by keeping Harper-assigned @createdTime/@updatedTime fields out of every record this app writes. Auth scope is untouched and correct: MenuAdminApi and OrderAdminApi still open every method — including `connect`/`subscribe` — with `requireAdmin()` before any db access, `static loadAsInstance = false` and `target.checkPermission = false` are in place, refusals remain the thrown 403 from runAuthed() with no 401 anywhere, and the public resources (MenuApi, StoreInfoApi, CheckoutApi, OrderConfirmationApi) are unchanged and match their plan rules. The writes still restate only server-derived fields, so a forged id, code, total, paymentStatus or customer field in a body changes nothing. No secrets, no new fetch host (lib/stripe-events.js and lib/retention.js only gained `withoutManaged`), no new dependency, no injection-shaped copy, no seed-data change, and schema.graphql gained comments only. Idempotency is preserved or improved: the webhook paths in lib/stripe-events.js now drop `updatedAt` off their spreads, which removes a refusal that would have answered Stripe 500 and left a paid order out of the queue. `lib/managed-fields.js` holds no state and the new managed-fields-probe parses every schema*.graphql so the hand-transcribed map cannot drift silently. Two process findings only: an out-of-area edit to deploy/smoke.txt that deletes two public-endpoint smoke rows, and a hand-written probe registration in package.json. Both are liveable and neither is an auth, secret or data hole.
